# Chabad of Fredericksburg 2nd Annual Gala

> Formal fundraising gala hosted by Chabad of Fredericksburg (Fredericksburg, VA): dinner, a live concert with the Shavrock Band, and sponsor and digital tribute opportunities.

## Event facts
- Event: Chabad of Fredericksburg 2nd Annual Gala
- Date: Tuesday, December 1, 2026 (21 Kislev 5787)
- Time: 6:00 PM (Eastern Time)
- Venue: The Maxine and Carl D. Silver Chabad Jewish Center at UMW
- Address: 1500 College Avenue, Fredericksburg, VA 22401, United States
- Entertainment: Live Concert with the Shavrock Band
- Organizer: Chabad of Fredericksburg
- Contact: rabbi@jewishumw.org

## Tribute Committee levels (Includes Dinner & Digital Tribute)
- Emerald: $25,000
- Ruby: $18,000
- Sapphire: $10,000
- Gold: $3,600
- Silver: $1,800

## Digital Tributes (Displayed on a loop throughout the evening)
- Full-Screen Digital Tribute: $1,000
- Half-Screen Digital Tribute: $720
- Quarter-Screen Digital Tribute: $360
- Name Listing (Supporter Scroll): $250

## Host Committee (in formation)
Mushky & Rabbi Shaya Gourarie, Nechomie & Rabbi Yossel Kranz, Deborah & Larry D. Silver, Dr. Kelly & Dr. Troy Paino, Spencer Silver, Rhonda & Adam Fried, Wendy Rice & Jeff Small, Rabbi Josh Broide
